h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Phagwara

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Phagwara

items.pText: Phagwara is in the Doaba region of Punjab, where many families have relatives settled in Canada, the UK and elsewhere. Some of our enquiries for Phagwara and nearby villages come from abroad. It may be a family giving a play area to the village school, or a trust funding equipment for a gurdwara ground or a public park.

FunPlay Systems can plan these projects remotely. We make the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,350 km from Phagwara. It goes to Punjab by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in the north. The town is also home to schools, colleges and housing colonies that buy for themselves. Wherever you are, send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a donated playground from a distance

c: Ask someone at the site to take photos from each corner, plus a short video walking around the ground. Note where the gate, the building and any trees are. With that, we can draw the layout and share it by email for approval.
Decide early who will look after the equipment once it is installed, such as the school, the gurdwara committee or the panchayat. They should receive the maintenance steps at handover. A
design from Funplay Originals, inspired by Indian games, makes a fitting gift for a village ground.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,350 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can we order a playground for a village near Phagwara from abroad?
items.a: Yes. We can plan it from photos and measurements sent by someone at the site, share the layout and quote by email, and install the equipment through our team or a dealer.

items.q: Who should look after a donated playground?
items.a: Whoever manages the site, such as the school or the committee. We hand over maintenance steps at installation, and our after-sales team can be reached for spare parts.

items.q: Do you supply Jalandhar, Ludhiana and other Doaba towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to towns across Punjab, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
